provenance.name: NASA GRACE & GRACE-FO JPL Tellus Land Mass Grids (RL06.1 v04)
provenance.license: NASA Open Data Policy (CC0 Equivalent / Public Domain)
provenance.citation: Landerer, F. W. and S. C. Swenson (2012), Accuracy of scaled GRACE terrestrial water storage estimates. Water Resources Research, 48(4), W04531.
provenance.spatialResolution: 300 km equivalent Gaussian smoothing footprint (~3 degrees), gridded to 0.5 degrees
provenance.processingLineage: Parametric harmonic model synthesized from published regional literature baselines and trends (Landerer & Swenson 2012, Rodell et al. 2009) with 300km Gaussian filter equivalent, formal error estimates, and explicit 11-month mission gap; not a direct binary NetCDF extraction.
knownLimitations: GRACE measures integrated regional mass anomalies (Liquid Water Equivalent in cm), combining groundwater, soil moisture, surface water, snow, and vegetation biomass.
Coarse spatial resolution (~300 km); MUST NOT be interpreted as direct single-borewell or village-level water depth.
Mission Gap: No observations exist between July 2017 and May 2018 (GRACE decommission to GRACE-FO commissioning). Gap must be displayed as missing data, not interpolated.

provenance.name: NASA Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM) IMERG Final Monthly Precipitation (V07)
provenance.provider: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (GSFC) & GES DISC
provenance.license: NASA Open Earth Science Data Policy (Public Domain)
provenance.citation: Huffman, G. J., et al. (2020), GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 month 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07, Greenbelt, MD, Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center (GES DISC).
provenance.spatialResolution: 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree (~10 km x 10 km)
provenance.processingLineage: Climatological monthly synthesis calibrated against regional IMD and NASA GPM IMERG literature distributions and historical annual aggregates (Huffman et al. 2020); not an automated HDF5 binary raster slice.
knownLimitations: Satellite estimates over complex orographic mountain slopes require rain-gauge calibration.
Precipitation is surface atmospheric input and does not equal aquifer recharge (which is modulated by evapotranspiration, infiltration, and soil vadose mechanics).

provenance.name: Central Ground Water Board (CGWB) & India-WRIS National Observation Well Network
provenance.provider: Central Ground Water Board (CGWB) & National Water Informatics Centre (NWIC)
provenance.license: Government of India Open Data License (GODL-India)
provenance.citation: Central Ground Water Board (2024), Ground Water Year Book - State-wise Periodic Monitoring Reports (2014-2024), Ministry of Jal Shakti, New Delhi.
provenance.temporalResolution: Seasonal cycles (Pre-monsoon May, Post-monsoon Nov, Jan, Aug)
provenance.processingLineage: Curated representative seasonal piezometric dipping sequence synthesized from published CGWB regional groundwater yearbooks and district information booklets; not a direct automated database export from India-WRIS.
knownLimitations: Point measurements reflect localized hydraulic head at the well screen depth only.
Local drawdown cones from adjacent private agricultural tubewells can introduce temporary seasonal drawdown bias.
Piezometric head indicates water table elevation, not total volumetric storage capacity of the aquifer.
